_readme: Theogony -m13 (US-014) SCG configuration. Static defaults, edit for advanced use. defcon: the default remediation level for -m13 --remediate (5 = settings and policies only, the safest; 4 adds service/feature state; 3 adds VM power cycles and switch security; 2 adds lock-out risks; 1 adds reboots and the TLS cut-over); --defcon N on the command line overrides it for one run. controls: the DEFCON grade per SCG control in this nested lab, with via = script (Broadcom remediation script), python (Theogony) or manual (no automation), and switch = the opt-in flag Broadcom's script also needs. remediate_vms: your own VMs (names or wildcards) that remediation may touch; VCF appliances are never touched. appliance_vms: VCF appliance VMs (names or wildcards) to report as APPLIANCE when Broadcom's notes-based check misses them. exceptions: accepted deviations (type exception) and controls verified by hand (type attested), each with a justification; approved_by is the architect (entries without it are reported as not approved); expires is optional (YYYY-MM-DD).
_appliance_vms: VCF appliances Broadcom's check misses (it only flags VMs whose notes mention VMware): NSX Manager (hesmpc-22), VCF Operations (hesmpc-24), VCF services platform nodes (hesmpc-27-*), fleet management (hesmpc-31), VCF Automation node (hesmpc-35-*). Reported as APPLIANCE and never remediated, like vCenter (hesmpc-21), the collector (hesmpc-25) and hesmpc-26.

esx-9.hardware-virtual-nic.note: Net.BMCNetworkEnable=0; nested hosts have no BMC

esx-9.log-forwarding-tls-x509.note: strict x509 for TLS syslog; harmless before US-019 adds a target

esx-9.memeagerzero.note: adds VM shutdown time proportional to memory

esx-9.memory-tiering-encryption.note: Mem.EncryptTierNvme=1 set by Theogony (Broadcom's script reports UPDATE without changing it); no memory tiering in the lab, so no effect

esx-9.password-complexity.note: new ESX root passwords need 15+ chars and all classes; existing ones keep working

esx-9.shell-timeout.note: SSH/Shell services stop after the timeout once started; running sessions stay

esx-9.shell-warning.note: Theogony's kickstart suppressed it; fixed in esxi_kickstart.script

vcenter-9.account-lockout-duration.note: vsphere.local policy in vCenter's directory (vmdir), read and set by Theogony over LDAPS

vcenter-9.account-lockout-max-attempts.note: vsphere.local policy in vCenter's directory (vmdir), read and set by Theogony over LDAPS

vcenter-9.account-lockout-reset.note: vsphere.local policy in vCenter's directory (vmdir), read and set by Theogony over LDAPS

vcenter-9.password-complexity.note: vsphere.local policy in vCenter's directory (vmdir), read and set by Theogony over LDAPS

vcenter-9.password-history.note: vsphere.local policy in vCenter's directory (vmdir), read and set by Theogony over LDAPS

vcenter-9.password-max-age.note: vsphere.local policy in vCenter's directory (vmdir), read and set by Theogony over LDAPS

vcenter-9.vpxuser-length.note: config.vpxd.hostPasswordLength=32 (the default); Theogony creates the key, which Broadcom's script cannot

esx-9.deactivate-shell.note: local ESX Shell only; SSH is a separate service (esx-9.ssh)

esx-9.log-audit-local.note: writes audit records to the host's persistent log location

vcenter-9.network-restrict-discovery-pro.note: turns off CDP/LLDP on the vDS

esx-9.vib-trusted-binaries.note: execInstalledOnly: only binaries from signed VIBs run

vcenter-9.service-resilience-evc.note: EVC baseline on the cluster; running VMs above it need a power cycle

vm-9.*.note: only VMs listed in remediate_vms (this file); a snapshot is taken first; never VCF appliances

esx-9.firewall-restrict-access.note: allow-lists per firewall ruleset; a wrong list cuts off vCenter, SDDC Manager or Theogony

esx-9.lockdown-mode.note: direct host access ends; SDDC Manager/Theogony need exception users

esx-9.tls-ciphers.note: TLS 1.3 only; every host reboots (rolling, vSAN resync)

vcenter-9.tls-ciphers.note: TLS 1.3 only; vCenter services restart; every client must speak TLS 1.3

esx-9.log-forwarding.note: needs a log target: US-019 (Log Management)

esx-9.log-audit-forwarding.note: needs a log target: US-019 (Log Management)

vcenter-9.log-forwarding.note: needs a log target: US-019 (Log Management)

exceptions.justification: Nested ESX hosts (US-007) run as VMs on esx02 without a vTPM; TPM 2.0 cannot be provided to them.
TPM-based configuration encryption needs a TPM (see esx-9.hardware-tpm).
No TPM-based configuration encryption, so there is no recovery key to back up (see esx-9.hardware-tpm).
Nested ESX hosts boot from a remastered kickstart ISO (US-007); UEFI Secure Boot is not enabled on the nested VMs.
Depends on UEFI Secure Boot (see esx-9.hardware-secureboot).
Nested ESX hosts have no hardware management controller (BMC/iDRAC).
No log target yet: VCF Operations Log Management arrives with US-019 (Sprint 4); forwarding is configured then.
